Lemon Shortbread Cookies
By: Anonymous
Published: Wednesday, December 23, 2009 - 11:55pm

Ingredients




2 cups flour
3/4 cup powdered sugar
1 cup butter or margarine
2 teaspoons lemon extract

Preparation

1 Combine well on medium speed of mixer. Dough will be texture of pie crust. 2 Roll into 1 inch balls. Place on greased cookie sheet. Flatten with fork. 3 Bake at 350 F for 15-20 minutes. 4 Description: "Deliciously light and very easy to make." Yield: 30 cookiesStart to Finish Time:"1:00"T(Baking):"0:15" 5 Serving Ideas : With a vanilla or chocolate pudding, this would be a great d 6 NOTES : Instead of rolling into balls, I use a small cookie dipper. 7 Makes it even faster. 8 Try substituting other flavorings for a nice variety. 9 Tested recipe.
